title: Closed-system kits and the straight-tip allowance on Original Medicare refills: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program shares its monthly limit with closed-system catheter kits (A4353) shipped on the same program. The straight-tip allowance is 200 units per 30 days.

## Clause

The program's closed-system kit shipments, judged on the ship date of the refill, set the covered limit per 30 days:

- **Kits within the last 3 calendar months.** When closed-system catheter kits shipped on the program within the last 3 calendar months, the covered limit per 30 days is replaced by the allowance of 200 less the newest kit order's quantity per 30 days. The newest kit order is the closed-system kit (A4353) written order with the latest order date.
- **Kits within the last 12 calendar months but none within the last 3.** The covered limit is replaced by the allowance of 200 less one twelfth of the kit units shipped in those 12 months, rounded down.
- **Otherwise** the covered limit stays the allowance of 200.

A kit shipment is within the last 3 calendar months when it is dated fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the ship date. A kit shipped on the same calendar day three months earlier is outside the window, and one shipped the following day is inside it. The 12-month window is read the same way with 12 months.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Kit shipments on the program | Newest kit order | Covered limit per 30 days |
|---|---|---|
| a kit refill 5 weeks before the ship date | 40 per 30 days | 200 less 40, which is 160 |
| none in the last 3 months; 150 kit units in the last 12 months | any | 200 less 12 (150 divided by 12 is 12.5, rounded down to 12), which is 188 |
| none in the last 12 months | any | 200 |
